spec.description: Who logs in, who fails and with which username, who knocks without a session, and is Authelia healthy?

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({container="authelia", level=~"debug|error"} |~ `(Successful|Unsuccessful) \w+ authentication attempt (made )?by user '[^']|do not exist` | regexp `'(?P<user>[^']+)'` | logfmt remote_ip | label_format outcome=`{{ if contains "banned until" __line__ }}banned{{ else if contains "do not exist" __line__ }}unknown user{{ else if contains "Unsuccessful" __line__ }}wrong password{{ else }}success{{ end }}` | outcome="success" [$__range]))

spec.description: Password logins that got through.
spec.title: Successful logins

spec.expr: sum by (remote_ip, outcome) (count_over_time({container="authelia", level=~"debug|error"} |~ `(Successful|Unsuccessful) \w+ authentication attempt (made )?by user '[^']|do not exist` | regexp `'(?P<user>[^']+)'` | logfmt remote_ip | label_format outcome=`{{ if contains "banned until" __line__ }}banned{{ else if contains "do not exist" __line__ }}unknown user{{ else if contains "Unsuccessful" __line__ }}wrong password{{ else }}success{{ end }}` [$__range]))

spec.description: Source addresses of login attempts. Click an address to look it up.
spec.title: Login sources

spec.expr: sum by (wd, hour) (count_over_time({container="authelia", level=~"debug|error"} |~ `(Successful|Unsuccessful) \w+ authentication attempt (made )?by user '[^']|do not exist` | regexp `'(?P<user>[^']+)'` | logfmt remote_ip | label_format outcome=`{{ if contains "banned until" __line__ }}banned{{ else if contains "do not exist" __line__ }}unknown user{{ else if contains "Unsuccessful" __line__ }}wrong password{{ else }}success{{ end }}` | logfmt time | time != "" | label_format hour=`{{ substr 11 13 .time }}`, wd=`{{ $d := substr 0 10 .time | toDate "2006-01-02" | date "Mon" }}{{ if eq $d "Mon" }}1 Mon{{ else if eq $d "Tue" }}2 Tue{{ else if eq $d "Wed" }}3 Wed{{ else if eq $d "Thu" }}4 Thu{{ else if eq $d "Fri" }}5 Fri{{ else if eq $d "Sat" }}6 Sat{{ else if eq $d "Sun" }}7 Sun{{ end }}` [$__range])) or (sum by (wd, hour) (count_over_time({container="authelia"} | logfmt time | time != "" | label_format hour=`{{ substr 11 13 .time }}`, wd=`{{ $d := substr 0 10 .time | toDate "2006-01-02" | date "Mon" }}{{ if eq $d "Mon" }}1 Mon{{ else if eq $d "Tue" }}2 Tue{{ else if eq $d "Wed" }}3 Wed{{ else if eq $d "Thu" }}4 Thu{{ else if eq $d "Fri" }}5 Fri{{ else if eq $d "Sat" }}6 Sat{{ else if eq $d "Sun" }}7 Sun{{ end }}` [$__range])) * 0)

spec.description: Login attempts by weekday and hour, server time. Darker means more.
spec.title: When logins happen

spec.expr: {container="authelia", level=~"debug|error"} |~ `(Successful|Unsuccessful) \w+ authentication attempt (made )?by user '[^']|do not exist` | regexp `'(?P<user>[^']+)'` | logfmt remote_ip | label_format outcome=`{{ if contains "banned until" __line__ }}banned{{ else if contains "do not exist" __line__ }}unknown user{{ else if contains "Unsuccessful" __line__ }}wrong password{{ else }}success{{ end }}` | line_format `{{ if eq .outcome "success" }}✅{{ else if eq .outcome "banned" }}⛔{{ else if eq .outcome "unknown user" }}❓{{ else }}❌{{ end }} {{ .user }}  ·  {{ .outcome }}  ·  {{ .remote_ip }}`

spec.description: Newest first. ✅ success, ❌ wrong password, ❓ unknown username, ⛔ banned.
spec.title: Recent attempts

spec.expr: count(sum by (user) (count_over_time({container="authelia", level="debug"} |= "Check authorization of subject" | regexp `subject username=(?P<user>\S*) .* object \w+://(?P<svc>[^./: ]+)` | label_format user=`{{ or .user "anonymous" }}` | user!="anonymous" [$__range])))

spec.description: Distinct logged-in users who opened a protected service.
spec.title: Active users

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({container="authelia", level="debug"} |= "Check authorization of subject" | regexp `subject username=(?P<user>\S*) .* object \w+://(?P<svc>[^./: ]+)` | label_format user=`{{ or .user "anonymous" }}` | user!="anonymous" [$__range]))

spec.description: Forward-auth checks for logged-in users.
spec.title: Requests by logged-in users

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({container="authelia", level="info"} |= "is not authorized to user <anonymous>" | regexp `Access to \w+://(?P<svc>[^./: ]+)[^/ ]*(?P<path>/[^/? ]*)` | logfmt remote_ip [$__range]))

spec.description: Requests to a protected service without a session, sent to the login page. Mostly internet scanners.
spec.title: Unauthenticated requests

spec.expr: count(sum by (remote_ip) (count_over_time({container="authelia", level="info"} |= "is not authorized to user <anonymous>" | regexp `Access to \w+://(?P<svc>[^./: ]+)[^/ ]*(?P<path>/[^/? ]*)` | logfmt remote_ip [$__range])))

spec.description: Distinct addresses that hit a protected service without a session.
spec.title: Unauthenticated IPs

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({container="authelia", level="info"} |= "is forbidden to user" | regexp `Access to \w+://(?P<svc>[^./: ]+).* is forbidden to user '(?P<user>[^']+)'` [$__range]))

spec.description: Logged-in users refused by an access rule (403), e.g. a wiki-only user opening Grafana.
spec.title: Access denied

spec.expr: sum by (user, svc) (count_over_time({container="authelia", level="debug"} |= "Check authorization of subject" | regexp `subject username=(?P<user>\S*) .* object \w+://(?P<svc>[^./: ]+)` | label_format user=`{{ or .user "anonymous" }}` [$__range]))

spec.description: Forward-auth checks per user and service. "anonymous" is every request without a session.
spec.title: Who uses which service

spec.expr: sum by (svc) (count_over_time({container="authelia", level="info"} |= "is not authorized to user <anonymous>" | regexp `Access to \w+://(?P<svc>[^./: ]+)[^/ ]*(?P<path>/[^/? ]*)` | logfmt remote_ip [$__auto]))

spec.description: Requests without a session, sent to the login page. Background scanning shows up as a steady floor.
spec.title: Unauthenticated requests by service

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({container="authelia", level=~"debug|error"} |~ `(Successful|Unsuccessful) \w+ authentication attempt (made )?by user '[^']|do not exist` | regexp `'(?P<user>[^']+)'` | logfmt remote_ip | label_format outcome=`{{ if contains "banned until" __line__ }}banned{{ else if contains "do not exist" __line__ }}unknown user{{ else if contains "Unsuccessful" __line__ }}wrong password{{ else }}success{{ end }}` | outcome!="success" [$__range]))

spec.description: Wrong password, unknown username or banned user.
spec.title: Failed logins

spec.expr: topk(15, sum by (remote_ip) (count_over_time({container="authelia", level="info"} |= "is not authorized to user <anonymous>" | regexp `Access to \w+://(?P<svc>[^./: ]+)[^/ ]*(?P<path>/[^/? ]*)` | logfmt remote_ip [$__range])))

spec.description: Top 15 addresses by requests without a session. Click a bar to look the address up.
spec.title: Busiest unauthenticated IPs

spec.expr: topk(20, sum by (path) (count_over_time({container="authelia", level="info"} |= "is not authorized to user <anonymous>" | regexp `Access to \w+://(?P<svc>[^./: ]+)[^/ ]*(?P<path>/[^/? ]*)` | logfmt remote_ip [$__range])))

spec.description: Top 20 first path segments requested without a session. /.env, /.git and /.aws are scanners looking for leaked secrets.
spec.title: Most probed paths

spec.expr: sum by (user, svc) (count_over_time({container="authelia", level="info"} |= "is forbidden to user" | regexp `Access to \w+://(?P<svc>[^./: ]+).* is forbidden to user '(?P<user>[^']+)'` [$__range]))

spec.description: Logged-in users refused by an access rule, per service.
spec.title: Access denied

spec.title: Status

spec.title: Memory

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({container="authelia", level="error"} != "Request timeout occurred" !~ "Unsuccessful|do not exist" [$__range]))

spec.description: Error lines, leaving out failed logins (see the Logins tab) and the harmless keep-alive timeouts.
spec.title: Service errors

spec.title: Certificate

spec.expr: sum by (level) (count_over_time({container="authelia", level=~".+"} [$__auto]))

spec.description: Authelia logs at debug level, so every forward-auth check is a line.
spec.title: Log lines by level

spec.expr: count(sum by (user) (count_over_time({container="authelia", level=~"debug|error"} |~ `(Successful|Unsuccessful) \w+ authentication attempt (made )?by user '[^']|do not exist` | regexp `'(?P<user>[^']+)'` | logfmt remote_ip | label_format outcome=`{{ if contains "banned until" __line__ }}banned{{ else if contains "do not exist" __line__ }}unknown user{{ else if contains "Unsuccessful" __line__ }}wrong password{{ else }}success{{ end }}` | outcome="unknown user" [$__range])))

spec.description: Distinct usernames tried that do not exist. Guessing, typos or a disabled account.
spec.title: Unknown usernames

spec.expr: sum by (kind) (count_over_time({container="authelia", level="error"} | logfmt msg | label_format kind=`{{ regexReplaceAll "'[^']*'" .msg "'…'" }}` [$__range]))

spec.description:
Error lines grouped by message, with names and values replaced by '…'.

"Request timeout occurred" comes from Traefik (remote_ip is the proxy): it keeps idle keep-alive connections to Authelia open, and Authelia logs a 408 when it closes one. Harmless.
spec.title: Errors by kind

spec.expr: max(container_memory_working_set_bytes{name="authelia"})
max(container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{name="authelia"})

spec.description: Container working set and its limit.
spec.title: Memory

spec.expr: sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name="authelia"}[$__rate_interval])) / (max(container_spec_cpu_quota{name="authelia"}) / max(container_spec_cpu_period{name="authelia"}))

spec.description: CPU use against the container's 0.5 CPU limit.
spec.title: CPU

spec.expr: sum by (success) (increase(authelia_authn_duration_sum[$__range])) / sum by (success) (increase(authelia_authn_duration_count[$__range]))

spec.description: Average time to check a password. A successful check runs argon2id, an unknown user returns almost at once; Authelia pads responses so the difference doesn't leak who exists.

spec.expr: sum by (code) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{service="authelia-docker@docker"}[$__interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service="authelia-docker@docker"}[$__rate_interval])))
